fact: A derro patrol spots the party 100 feet down a path in the western tunnels.
source_quote: About 100 feet down that path, a derro patrol spotted them.
subject: derro patrol encounter

fact: The party attempts to bypass the derro patrol with a casual stroll, aided by a deception roll of 21.
source_quote: The party tried a casual, confident stroll past, helped by the derros' wretched wisdom and a deception roll of 21.
subject: deception attempt

fact: The derro have an intelligence and wisdom score of 3 and a perception score of 7.
source_quote: the derro have intelligence and wisdom of 3 and a perception of 7
subject: derro

fact: The derro attack immediately after Gyrgum declares his devotion to Bahamut.
source_quote: Gyrgum declared his devotion to Bahamut, and the derro attacked at once.
subject: combat start

fact: Bahamut is the deity worshipped by Gyrgum.
source_quote: Gyrgum declared his devotion to Bahamut
subject: Bahamut

fact: Thorin wins initiative with a roll of 19.
source_quote: Thorin won initiative with a 19
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin hits a derro with his longsword for 6 damage.
source_quote: His longsword hits (13) for 6 damage
subject: Thorin attacks derro

fact: Thorin's Sap mastery leaves his target at disadvantage on its next attack.
source_quote: his Sap mastery leaves his target at disadvantage
subject: Thorin uses Sap

fact: Zalthir moves his magical darkness over two of the enemies.
source_quote: Zalthir moved his magical darkness over two of the enemies
subject: Zalthir uses darkness

fact: Zalthir scores a critical unarmed strike from inside the darkness for 12 damage.
source_quote: scored a critical unarmed strike from inside it
subject: Zalthir attacks derro

fact: The critical strike leaves the targeted derro at a single hit point.
source_quote: leaving one at a single hit point
subject: Derro weakened

fact: Daz splits magic missiles across the patrol.
source_quote: Daz split magic missiles across the patrol
subject: Daz attacks patrol

fact: Gyrgum hits the derro with Tasha's Caustic Brew.
source_quote: Gyrgum hit them with Tasha's Caustic Brew
subject: Gyrgum casts Brew

fact: Thorin cuts down a derro that tries to go after Zalthir using a Guardian stance.
source_quote: Thorin took up a Guardian stance and cut down a derro that tried to go after Zalthir
subject: Thorin guards Zalthir

fact: Gyrgum parries a hooked spear while debating theology with his attacker.
source_quote: Gyrgum parried a hooked spear while calmly debating theology with his attacker
subject: Gyrgum parries

fact: Gyrgum casts True Strike on his mace.
source_quote: He then cast True Strike
subject: Gyrgum casts True Strike

fact: Gyrgum kills the last standing derro with a bone-crushing blow of his mace.
source_quote: killed the last standing derro with a bone-crushing blow of his mace
subject: Last derro killed

fact: The party continues down the underground corridor after the patrol is defeated.
source_quote: With the patrol defeated, the party continues down the underground corridor
subject: Patrol defeated

fact: The allied crew attacks twice for 8 and 4 damage, leaving one derro at 1 hit point.
source_quote: The allied crew attacks twice, for 8 and 4 damage, leaving one derro at 1 hit point
subject: Derro wounded by allies

fact: The derro swing back with hooked spears at Zalthir and miss.
source_quote: The derro swing back with hooked spears at Zalthir and miss
subject: Derro misses Zalthir

fact: Derro number four fails its save against Tasha's Caustic Brew and is coated in acid that burns each turn.
source_quote: derro number four fails and is coated in acid that burns each turn until scraped off
subject: Derro covered in acid

fact: A derro charges Gyrgum screaming about death to Bahamut.
source_quote: A derro charges Gyrgum screaming about death to Bahamut
subject: Derro charges Gyrgum

fact: Thorin kills his opponent with 7 damage.
source_quote: Thorin kills his opponent with another 7 damage
subject: Thorin kills derro

fact: Thorin's opportunity attack deals 7 damage and cuts down derro number four.
source_quote: Thorin's opportunity attack deals 7 and cuts it down
subject: Thorin opportunity attack

fact: Daz fires magic missiles that drop a derro to 3 hit points.
source_quote: Daz fires more magic missiles: two at the derro with 6 hit points and one at the derro with 8, dropping it to 3
subject: Daz finishes derro

fact: Zalthir's attacks all miss due to low rolls.
source_quote: Zalthir's attacks all miss (the GM rolls a 2 and a 1)
subject: Zalthir misses

fact: The last derro goes splattering across the ground with broken vertebrae.
source_quote: goes splattering across the ground with a couple of broken vertebrae
subject: Final derro dies

fact: The patrol consists of four derro guards.
source_quote: The party encounters a patrol of four derro guards
subject: derro patrol

fact: The derro are fanatical cultists of the dual-headed master.
source_quote: The fanatical cultists attack at once
subject: derro

fact: Thorin leads the attack in the first round of combat.
source_quote: Thorin leads the attack
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum remarks with quiet arrogance that one head is better than two while standing over the fallen patrol.
source_quote: Standing over the fallen patrol, he remarked with quiet arrogance that one head was indeed better than two
subject: Gyrgum
